svg.title: iPawcus - System Class Diagram
svg.desc: Conceptual UML class diagram. White three-compartment class boxes with thin gray borders and orthogonal relationships. Attributes and operations describe the existing system, not literal PHP class declarations.
svg.text: Conceptual UML model | class name, attributes, operations | + public | ? nullable
Solid: association | dashed: application association | dashed arrow: uses | 1 / 0..1 / 0..* multiplicities
Core classes and selected attributes. Full class definitions and relationships are on the complete and detail sheets.
